Version 0.81.0

### ✨ New

- Added built-in DeepSeek Harness support, including direct DeepSeek API key configuration, Agent presets, and Lody MCP access in sessions.
- Independent sessions created by Agents or child sessions are now grouped under their originating session, with bidirectional relationship details and quick navigation.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Improved scroll following in long conversations and streaming responses, reducing unexpected jumps after small upward scrolls.
- Improved narrow-screen mobile settings layouts, separators, and action-button readability.
- Fixed workspace files sometimes failing to preview or save when path capitalization or Unicode normalization differs, or when filenames contain special characters.
- Restored the taskbar icon on Linux KDE desktop environments.
